company.shortDescription: Hepatx is developing regenerative medicine solutions.
company.description: HepaTx is developing regenerative medicine solutions to address the need for better therapies for life-threatening liver diseases. The technology invented at Stanford University enables efficient hepatocyte production for therapeutic purposes. Its therapeutics can replace lost liver function to treat those with end-stage of liver disease, potentially saving the cost and morbidity of whole organ transplant.

aiResearchSummary.text: HepaTx is engaged in regenerative medicine solutions, as reflected in the work titled Methods of tracking donor cells in a recipient. This research describes methods for detecting and monitoring the function of a donor cell in a recipient by identifying specific isoforms of polypeptides, where the donor and recipient express different isoforms. The focus is on tracking and evaluating donor cell integration and function, highlighting advancements in cell-based regenerative therapies.
